title: Geometric Filtering of LLM-Generated Samples for Few-Shot Text Classification
abstract: arXiv:2608.13866v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate synthetic training data for text classification, but the quality of generated samples is heterogeneous: some fall in correct class regions of the embedding space while others land in peripheral or cross-class zones. We propose a geometric filtering framework that evaluates each LLM-generated sample by its Euclidean distance to real class examples in a sentence embedding space, selecting only geometrically consistent candidates. A soft weighting mechanism transforms filter scores into sample weights for classifier training. Evaluated across 13 datasets, 5 classifiers, 10 augmentation methods, and over 6,700 configurations, our method achieves +2.61 percentage points (pp) over SMOTE ($p<0.0001$, Cohen's $d=0.95$, 88.9% win rate). The approach generalizes to named entity recognition (+9.26pp, 100% win rate) without filter modification, and is robust across 5 LLMs from 4 providers. A key finding is

translated_title: 基于几何过滤的LLM生成样本用于少样本文本分类
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）可以为文本分类生成合成训练数据，但生成样本的质量参差不齐：有些样本落在嵌入空间的正确类别区域，而其他样本则位于边缘或跨类别区域。我们提出了一种几何过滤框架，通过计算每个LLM生成样本在句子嵌入空间中与真实类别示例的欧几里得距离来评估其质量，仅选择几何一致的候选样本。一种软加权机制将过滤分数转换为用于分类器训练的样本权重。在13个数据集、5个分类器、10种增强方法和超过6700种配置的评估中，我们的方法相比SMOTE平均提高了+2.61个百分点（p<0.0001，Cohen's d=0.95，88.9%胜率）。该方法无需修改过滤器即可泛化到命名实体识别任务（+9.26个百分点，100%胜率），并且对来自4个提供商的5种LLM具有鲁棒性。一个关键发现是...
tldr: 提出一种基于嵌入空间几何距离的过滤框架，通过选择与真实样本几何一致的LLM生成样本来提升少样本文本分类性能，在多种设置下显著优于现有方法。
en_tdlr: A geometric filtering framework selects LLM-generated samples consistent with real class examples in embedding space, improving few-shot text classification by +2.61pp over SMOTE across diverse settings.
